extension.summary: No gaps. No stale scores. Age ratings you can trust.
extension.description: MetaMender quietly improves your video library in the background. It fills in what your scraper left empty (plots, episode titles, credits, taglines, genres and more) from TMDB and TheTVDB, in each folder's own language, with an optional fallback language for empty fields. It keeps scores up to date while new movies and episodes collect votes, from TMDB and IMDb, then leaves them alone once they settle. And it gives movies and TV shows an age rating in your own country's system, for ten countries. If you tick them for a library, it also replaces washed-out frame grabs and broken episode thumbs with the official episode still from TMDB or TheTVDB; fills and refreshes posters, fanart, clear logos, key art and other art in your library's language, from TMDB and fanart.tv (you choose which is asked first; landscape, banner, disc art, clear art and character art come from fanart.tv only), with an English image only for empty art; and gives movie sets TMDB's name, plot and art in your library's language. Local image files stay, and so does art you change afterwards, but art whose local file you deleted is filled, once MetaMender can tell the share it lives on is reachable; a replaced image can be put back from the Details window. Items with an NFO file keep their values, and the Details window in the context menu shows where each value came from, can put an original back and can keep a value as it is. A short setup asks for a free TMDB API key, your library's languages and what to fill; nothing changes before it is finished.
extension.news:
v1.3.2 (2026-11-28) - After Kodi refreshes an item or you replace its video file, MetaMender puts its own values back and no longer locks the new art as your change - A library update no longer puts off the daily scan, and the scan after it skips libraries you left out, so it takes seconds - Movie sets: a second set of a collection is merged into the one MetaMender looks after, whatever its name - Items whose file or folder you deleted count as gone, not as an offline share - Update now and Details say so when Kodi lists a file twice
v1.3.1 (2026-11-26) - Movie sets: movies missing from their collection's set are added, and a collection without a set gets one - Movie sets: a movie you took out of its set before this version may be added back once; take it out again and it stays out - A library's settings page says whether it holds movies or TV shows and offers only the choices for that kind - Background, Stop and Back in the Update now window respond again on slower devices - The runtime Kodi reads from your video file is no longer overwritten on every scan
